lints.name: security_definer_view
lints.title: Security Definer View
lints.description: Detects views defined with the SECURITY DEFINER property. These views enforce Postgres permissions and row level security policies (RLS) of the view creator, rather than that of the querying user

findings.detail: View \`public.evaluator_proposals_app_view\` is defined with the SECURITY DEFINER property
View \`public.ml_calibration_report\` is defined with the SECURITY DEFINER property

findings.detail: Function \`public.ab_week1_decisions_set_updated_at\` has a role mutable search_path

lints.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.

findings.detail: Function `public.capture_event_record(p_device_key text, p_event jsonb)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/capture_event_record`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.ev_submit_decision(p_device_key text, p_envelope_text text)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/ev_submit_decision`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.ev_submit_outcome(p_device_key text, p_decision_id text, p_outcome_text text)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/ev_submit_outcome`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
